description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transform for formatting currency values in the OFBiz framework. It processes input arguments such as amount, ISO currency code, and locale, and outputs formatted currency strings, considering system properties for rounding and scaling.

classes.name: OfbizCurrencyTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class for formatting currency values in OFBiz.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling TemplateScalarModel types.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves and converts an argument to BigDecimal, handling nulls and different object types.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves and converts an argument to Integer, handling different object types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that formats and outputs currency based on input arguments, environment, and system properties.
